name: GOAL State Reports
tagline: Weather and market reports by state, built from public data.

ok.name: Oklahoma
ok.intro: Severe weather, wildfire and homeowner demographics for all 664 Oklahoma ZIP codes and 77 counties. Use them to decide where your agency spends on leads and inbound calls.

il.name: Illinois
il.intro: Hail exposure for all 102 Illinois counties and the 484 ZIP codes in the top 15, ranked by where roof-damaging hail meets owner-occupied homes. Use them to decide where your agency spends on leads and inbound calls.
